inputs.text: [excited] Thirty feet long — [amazed] as long as a truck. Standing up, nine feet tall — [curious] as tall as a basketball hoop. And four thousand kilos — [proud] as heavy as 2 rhinos. [calm] It walked calmly: 4 miles an hour, [pauses] like Dad walking fast.
[confident] Nope — [serious] it didn't need to be. Its tail did the work.
